name: beggar-codex
description: A Codex-native multi-agent engineering workflow with risk-based model routing, evidence-based quality gates, and optional GitHub delivery integration.

interface.longDescription: Beggar turns a software request into a stateful, evidence-driven engineering workflow. It routes clear low-risk tasks to a low-cost model, escalates high-risk or failed work, requires real verification, and supports optional GitHub Pull Request delivery.
defaultPrompt: Use Beggar to implement this request
Route this task by risk and verify the result
Review the current change and prepare a GitHub PR
